chapterEvidenceSpans: The source states: The 2007 iPhone launch framed the device as a practical convergence of phone, iPod, and internet communicator, not as a permanent social-feed companion. Because the original public story emphasized utility, the later expansion into constant feed checking shows how adopted tools can mutate after users accept them.   "text": "The 2007 iPhone launch framed the device as a practical convergence of phone, iPod, and internet communicator, not as a permanent social-feed companion. Because the original public story emphasized utility, the later expansion into constant feed checking shows how adopted tools can mutate after users accept them. The iPhone was introduced mainly as a social-media device, so later compulsive use was already the intended purpose.
